2609.30420.title: Understanding Perturbed Parameter Ensemble Sensitivities Using A Contrastive Learning Approach
2609.30420.paper_summary: Perturbed parameter ensembles (PPEs) reveal how physics parameters affect climate simulations, but interpreting parameter sensitivities across multivariate, spatially structured outputs remains challenging, particularly when calibrating models against observations. We develop an explainable contrastive learning model that maps 5 monthly cloud and radiation fields into a shared representation space. We train the model on the fields of two 100-member Community Atmosphere Model version 6 (CAM6) PPEs, spanning 34 parameters, that only differ in the warm rain microphysics scheme: KK2000, the default bulk microphysics scheme, and TAU-ML, a neural network emulator of a bin microphysics scheme. The learned representations separates two PPEs with over 94\% linear classification accuracy while preserving the seasonal variability and ensemble spread due to parameter perturbations. In the shared representation space, the representations of satellite observations occupy the same low-dimensional manifold as the PPEs but are displaced from them most strongly during boreal spring and autumn. TAU-ML PPE has a lower distance to observations compared to KK2000 in the representation space. Integrated Gradients attributions highlights the contributions in subtropical low-cloud regions, Northern and Southern Hemisphere storm track regions, and tropical convection regions to differences between PPEs and observations. Regional attributions correlate most strongly with parameters associated with cloud microphysics, boundary layer turbulence, and deep convection. These results demonstrate that explainable representations of climate fields can attribute model differences to specific variables, regions, seasons, and physical parameters.
2609.30420.paper_summary_zh: 擾動參數集合（PPEs）揭示了物理參數如何影響氣候模擬，但在對多變量、空間結構化輸出進行參數敏感性解釋時仍然具有挑戰性，尤其是在將模型與觀測數據進行校準時。我們開發了一種可解釋的對比學習模型，將5個月的雲和輻射場映射到共享表示空間。我們在兩個100成員的社區大氣模型第6版（CAM6）PPE的場上訓練該模型，涵蓋34個參數，這兩個PPE僅在暖雨微物理方案上有所不同：KK2000，默認的塊微物理方案，以及TAU-ML，一種二元微物理方案的神經網絡模擬器。學到的表示將兩個PPE以超過94\%的線性分類準確率區分開來，同時保留由參數擾動引起的季節變異性和集合擴散。在共享表示空間中，衛星觀測的表示佔據了與PPE相同的低維流形，但在北半球春季和秋季期間與它們的位移最為明顯。在表示空間中，TAU-ML PPE與觀測的距離低於KK2000。集成梯度歸因強調了亞熱帶低雲區、北半球和南半球風暴軌跡區以及熱帶對流區對PPE和觀測之間差異的貢獻。區域歸因與與雲微物理、邊界層湍流和深對流相關的參數最為強烈相關。這些結果表明，氣候場的可解釋表示可以將模型差異歸因於特定變量、區域、季節和物理參數。
